panels.title: Request rate by status class
panels.description: Filtered by the route picker above (grafana is excluded from the option list).

targets.expr: sum(rate({service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route"} | json status="status" | __error__="" | status >= 200 | status < 300 [5m]))
sum(rate({service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route"} | json status="status" | __error__="" | status >= 300 | status < 400 [5m]))
sum(rate({service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route"} | json status="status" | __error__="" | status >= 400 | status < 500 [5m]))

panels.title: Request rate by route
panels.description: app traffic only, grouped by the first URL path segment (rss, audio, search, home, robots.txt, ...).

panels.title: Blocked requests (User-Agent block)
panels.description: 403s from the BLOCKED_UA_REGEX map at the nginx edge - see proxy/templates/default.conf.template. Filtered by the route picker above.

panels.title: Response size sent
panels.description: Filtered by the route picker above (grafana is excluded from the option list).

targets.expr: sum(rate({service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route"} | json body_bytes_sent="body_bytes_sent" | __error__="" | unwrap body_bytes_sent [5m]))

panels.title: Request duration (p50 / p95)
panels.description: nginx's own $request_time - edge to response, includes time spent proxying to the app. Filtered by the route picker above.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route"} | json request_time="request_time" | __error__="" | unwrap request_time [5m])
quantile_over_time(0.95, {service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route"} | json request_time="request_time" | __error__="" | unwrap request_time [5m])

panels.title: Top requested URIs (excl. rss/audio)
panels.description: rss and audio URIs are one-off per show/episode (uuid path) and per-show breakdown already exists in the Analytics dashboard - including them here blows past Loki's per-query series limit without being useful. This panel is for spotting scanner/bot noise on other paths.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (uri) (count_over_time({service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route", route!~"rss|audio"} | json uri="uri" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top user agents
panels.description: Filtered by the route picker above (grafana is excluded from the option list).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route"} | json user_agent="user_agent" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top user agents fetching non-podcast pages
panels.description: Excludes rss/audio (legitimate podcast clients) to surface who's crawling the index, search, robots.txt, and other one-off/scanner paths - useful for deciding what to add to BLOCKED_UA_REGEX.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route", route!~"rss|audio"} | json user_agent="user_agent" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top IPs by route
panels.description: Real client IP, resolved from Cloudflare's CF-Connecting-IP header at the nginx edge (see proxy/templates/default.conf.template) - the app sits behind a Cloudflare Tunnel, so the raw TCP source is otherwise just the docker bridge gateway. Filtered by the route picker above.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (route, remote_addr) (count_over_time({service="reverseproxy", route=~"$route"} | json remote_addr="remote_addr" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Top shows by RSS requests
panels.description: Live equivalent of the Postgres-only "RSS requests per show" panel on the Analytics dashboard, but sourced straight from the nginx access log instead of the app's request_log table: show_id is pulled out of the uri (/rss/{show_id}) with a regex, then joined against the shows table just for the title. Doesn't depend on any app-side per-request logging.

panels.title: RSS pagination: non-zero page requests
panels.description: ?page=N on /rss/{showId} (see internal/httpapi/handlers.go) fetches older episodes past the feed's first page - 0-indexed, so page=0 is the default/first page and not shown here. Shows who's paging deep into a show's back catalog.

panels.title: Recent nginx logs
panels.description: Filtered by the route picker above (grafana is excluded from the option list).

panels.title: Top user agents by distinct RSS feeds requested
panels.description: Counts how many different shows (show_id, pulled out of the /rss/{show_id} uri) each user agent has fetched - a client hammering many feeds ranks higher here than one repeatedly polling a single feed. Always scoped to the rss route, independent of the route picker above.

targets.expr: topk(15, count by (user_agent) (sum by (user_agent, show_id) (count_over_time({service="reverseproxy", route="rss"} | json user_agent="user_agent" | __error__="" | regexp "\"uri\":\"/rss/(?P<show_id>[^\"]+)\"" [$__range]))))
